author: Patrikano
body:
Hi,

So a while back I made a post asking for help --> https://avicus.net/forums/0b279bbcf

And nobody seemed to know how to do it, but the map Tetris Plains does the thing I want:
http://imgur.com/a/5WRdN

Basically I want the rivers to meet in between the walls...
Anyone know how to do this? This obviously (from the screenshot) seems like it is used with YML

title: Mystery

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body: Make the rivers 1 block deep, so when the sand is removed the water can create new water blocks. (Like infinite water sources). Just fill the gap with sand, the walls plugin only removes sand so there shouldn't be a problem if you lower the region in the yml.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
^^^^^^

Just put sand in between the rivers like this

W = Water
S = Sand in one layer


WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW
WWWWWWWSWWWW

And the map will make it flow automatically (like an infinite source)
